endorsements.name: Dolev Farhi
endorsements.label: CVE-2018-25349
endorsements.description: userSpice 4.3.24 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject malicious scripts through the X-Forwarded-For HTTP header. Attackers can send crafted requests to the backup.php endpoint with XSS payloads in the X-Forwarded-For header that execute when administrators visit the audit log page.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.1)

endorsements.name: Dolev Farhi
endorsements.label: CVE-2018-25350
